mu.py comes from https://github.com/taniwha/io_object_mu/blob/master/mu.py.
Downloaded on 2026-10-04. It is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later, as stated in its header.
Used to inspect model data, locate material property offsets, and write
generated rigid KSP models in the ROD converter prototype. The original
license is retained. The converter's validation reader applies a local
material-property-count fix without modifying the vendored source.
